note: An experiment (GAME_SPEC §8, §13.7, Stage 91; docs/CURRICULUM.md, experiment 47) on data/benches/redox_titration.json: two redox titrations, permanganate into iron(II) in acid (its own colour the end point) and thiosulfate into iodine (the triiodide's yellow vanishing).
title: Experiment: redox titrations

steps.title: Your guess
steps.text: Permanganate, MnO4-, takes manganese from +7 to +2 in acid; iron(II) gives up one electron to become iron(III). How many iron(II) ions does one permanganate oxidise?

steps.title: Fill the burette with permanganate
steps.text: Pick up the permanganate, right-click burette1, type 55 and click "pour". Right-click burette1 and write down its reading.

steps.title: 25 mL of the iron(II) sulfate
steps.text: Pick up pipette1 and click the iron(II) sulfate: it draws up to its mark.

steps.title: Into the flask
steps.text: Pick up pipette1 again and click flask1: it runs into it.

steps.title: Until it is empty
steps.text: Wait until the pipette has run out.

steps.title: The burette over the flask, stirred
steps.text: Set the pipette back where it stood. Pick up burette1 and click flask1; right-click flask1 and stir it, so each drop meets the whole of it.

steps.title: Open the tap
steps.text: Right-click burette1, drag its tap fully open, and click 60x on the clock.

steps.title: Nearly there
steps.text: Each drop's purple vanishes as it meets the iron(II): MnO4- + 5 Fe2+ + 8 H+ -> Mn2+ + 5 Fe3+ + 4 H2O. Wait for 22 mL to run in.

steps.title: Shut it
steps.text: Drag burette1's tap shut.

steps.title: Drop by drop
steps.text: Open the tap a little, to about 5 %, and watch the flask.

steps.title: The end point
steps.text: Watch for the first drop whose purple stays: a pale pink that no longer fades.
steps.why: While iron(II) is left each drop of permanganate is used up at once and its purple vanishes; the first drop more stays. Permanganate is its own indicator.

steps.title: Shut it, read it
steps.text: Drag the tap shut and write down burette1's reading.

steps.title: Fill the burette with thiosulfate
steps.text: Pick up the thiosulfate, right-click burette2, type 55 and click "pour". Right-click burette2 and write down its reading.

steps.title: 25 mL of the iodine solution
steps.text: Pick up pipette2 and click the iodine solution: it draws up to its mark.

steps.title: Into the flask
steps.text: Pick up pipette2 again and click flask2: it runs into it.

steps.title: Until it is empty
steps.text: Wait until the pipette has run out.

steps.title: The burette over the flask, stirred
steps.text: Set the pipette back where it stood. Pick up burette2 and click flask2; right-click flask2 and stir it, so each drop meets the whole of it.

steps.title: Open the tap
steps.text: Right-click burette2, drag its tap fully open, and click 60x on the clock.

steps.title: Nearly there
steps.text: The iodine's brown fades to yellow as thiosulfate takes it: I2 + 2 S2O3 2- -> 2 I- + S4O6 2-. Wait for 22 mL to run in.

steps.title: Shut it
steps.text: Drag burette2's tap shut.

steps.title: Drop by drop
steps.text: Open the tap a little, to about 5 %, and watch the flask.

steps.title: The end point
steps.text: Watch the yellow fade: at the end point the last of it goes, and the flask is colourless.
steps.why: Triiodide's own yellow is the indicator here (starch, which turns it deep blue near the end, is not in this lab). Each drop of thiosulfate takes iodine back to iodide; the last yellow goes with the last iodine.

steps.title: Shut it, read it
steps.text: Drag the tap shut and write down burette2's reading.

report.label: iron(II) per permanganate
report.why: Manganese goes from +7 to +2, five electrons; each iron(II) gives one.

report.label: the permanganate run in
report.why: burette1's reading at the end less its reading at the start.

report.label: the iron(II) solution's concentration
report.why: 5 x 0.0200 x V / 25.00: five iron(II) for each permanganate.

report.label: the thiosulfate run in
report.why: burette2's reading at the end less its reading at the start.

report.label: the iodine solution's concentration
report.why: 0.100 x V / (2 x 25.00): two thiosulfates for each iodine.
